meta.originalInput: You’re judging your raw, chaotic behind-the-scenes against someone else’s polished highlight reel. On your feed, people broadcast their single peak hour out of hundreds of ordinary ones. You see their finished trophy, but you have to live through every quiet doubt, failed draft, and exhausting misstep of your own. You aren't falling behind. You’re just comparing your unedited rehearsal to their final opening night. Stop measuring your private foundation against someone else’s showroom. Build in quiet.
